title: 🎬 THE RIGHT BATTLE PROVES THE RIGHT ASSIGNMENT
paragraphs:
🎬 THE RIGHT BATTLE PROVES THE RIGHT ASSIGNMENT
When everything seems to rise against you, it’s not a sign of defeat — it’s confirmation that Heaven trusted you with the right mission. 💥
The weight of the battle only proves the worth of your calling.
Stand your ground. God didn’t bring you this far to abandon you. 🙌🔥

“Fight the good fight of faith, lay hold on eternal life, whereunto thou art also called.”
— 1 Timothy 6:12 (KJV)
If the fight feels heavier than usual — it’s because your purpose just got promoted. 💫
